consumer: mission::is_complete(MGOAL_FIND_ITEM), the engine's mission-completion check that asks yes/no whether the courier's required item quantity is satisfied; the dialogue/hand-in eligibility gate consumes that boolean.
scope: items reachable via the player's crafting_inventory() (carried items plus nearby reachable inventory), not only the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — computes a boolean by calling u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item_id, item_count), returning the engine's own completion predicate rather than a re-derivation from a snapshot.
divergence: The required courier item sits in a reachable container/tile adjacent to the player but is not worn/wielded/in inventory: is_complete() returns true (crafting_inventory includes it), but an answer derived from avatar.carried_items[] (Excerpt 2's wielded/worn/inventory scope) reports 'not ready' — wrong reach exposes the wrong answer.
